A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same MGLL research work and contain complete, readable main texts and Appendices A–E. Their equations, tables, figures, and appendix contents support reliable comparison after matching pagination and text reflow.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification, segmentation, multimodal diagnostic evaluation, and ablation results in Section 4 and Appendix D.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including benchmark comparisons, robustness experiments, and diagnostic case studies.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain the same encoder framework, soft CLIP loss, point-wise loss, and smooth KL divergence objective. The combined objective and its weights in Equation 7 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Training and evaluation coverage is unchanged, including fundus and X-ray datasets, ophthalmic multiple-choice diagnosis, and the appendix evaluations on ImageNet, OrganAMNIST, COVIDx, and COVID-Xray segmentation. All these tasks already appear in v1.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the classification, segmentation, MLLM, and ablation comparisons. VisionFM's Table 23 label changes from arXiv-24 to NEJM AI-24, but identifies the same method. The newly cited related works are not added as experimental comparators.

E3.justification: The reported splits, preprocessing, model configurations, metrics, and evaluation procedures remain unchanged in Section 4.1 and Appendices B–D. Appendix C.1 changes MAP to mAP only in capitalization; the metric and its use remain the same.

E4.justification: Both retain the loss, granularity, encoder, and image/text-quality ablations in Tables 3–8; weight, temperature, missing-label, and mixed-granularity analyses in Tables 35–38; and the same CAM visualizations and diagnostic case studies.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates without repeated-run counts, random-seed details, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: The numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, MGLL's RFMiD linear-probe/full-fine-tuning AUC remains 79.62/92.83 in Table 23, and its COVID-Xray segmentation Dice remains 81.69 in Table 25.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulations and reasoning in Section 3 and Appendix A are retained, including the soft-CLIP optimality argument, point-wise loss gradient derivation, and KL-divergence consistency analysis. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are substantively revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about simultaneous multi-label and cross-granularity alignment, architecture-agnostic objectives, constructed medical datasets, and downstream performance advantages.

C2.justification: The interpretations of benchmark gains, ablations, and visualizations remain unchanged, as do Appendix E's applicability discussion and future directions. The ethics statement retains the qualification that clinical use requires further validation and approval.

D1.justification: Appendix C.2 retains the same preprocessing, optimizer settings, batch size, temperature, and NVIDIA RTX A6000 hardware information. Dataset processing descriptions, the code link, and the reproducibility statement are unchanged; the revised dataset access date is bibliographic metadata.

R1.justification: Section 2.1 adds He et al. (2024, 2025), covering two concealed-object segmentation works, and Section 2.2 adds Wang et al. (2023), SwinMM. These three references supplement existing passages without substantially changing MGLL's positioning or novelty argument.

P1.justification: v2 lightly rewrites the introduction's medical-data motivation, standardizes mAP notation, cleans author-email formatting, and updates bibliographic titles and years. It adds a funding acknowledgment and publication-header text. The main section organization and appendix structure remain intact.

P2.justification: The same six figures and 38 tables retain their scientific content and organization. v2 adds an ICLR 2026 running header and makes small spacing and pagination adjustments, including reference reflow. Table 23's VisionFM venue label is updated without restructuring the table.

improvement.justification: v2 adds previously absent MIDRC funding disclosure on page 11 and improves internal consistency through mAP notation in Appendix C.1 and VisionFM's venue label in Table 23. These provide modest transparency and editorial gains. The method, experimental evidence, theory, and limitations remain unchanged.
